notes.title: Early Access Roadmap and Updated Release Date
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41497794/e5d460efd45cc4635dd645e8e3271c8a58eccee6.png[/img]


We've got a lot to cover in this news alert so let's get started! 

Firstly we have a Road Map for Early Access that give you an idea of what is going to be available and what is going to be waiting until later on. 

Secondly, we want to make sure everything is perfect for Beneath Oresa at launch, and this means we've had to updated the release date slightly to [b]November 3rd[/b] . We would rather take the extra couple weeks and make sure you're getting the best experience right from the start!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41497794/15e07c969e9277a50003fc69425d7c6f1a581f01.png[/img]

At Early Access Launch you'll have: 

[list]
[*] Over 40 foes and 8 bosses are already roaming Oresa.
[*] The collections are complete. All cards and all antiquorums are available to uncover.
[*] Runs can be played to the end with all intended chapters, events, and bonuses.
[*] Choose your difficulty - be able to increase the challenge each run
[/list]

The game will be [b]Fully Playable[/b] from the start, with balancing updates coming frequently, and feedback taken from the community on [url=https://discord.gg/qx6zNEXvWR]Discord[/url] and implemented. 

Coming Soon are the additional features: 

[list]
[*] Lost Legion (faction) - New power, characters and cardset
[*] Guild of the Ruinfarers (faction) - New power, characters and cardset
[*] Dozens of special runs with unique rules
[*] All new arena effects such as toxic gas, or darkness, add new strategy to fights.
[*] New arenas throughout Oresa and an additional Final Boss option. 
[/list]

We are as much players as developers: for us, a game - even in Early Access - must keep the maximum of its promises.
We worked hard to make sure a full game experience is available at Early Access launch.

Yes, we have planned new characters, new card collections, new faction powers, 
but the game provides complete runs with all chapters and events. 

With the current faction you will already face all the enemies of the abandoned city, with all the encounters and unique objects to discover.

In other words: everything is already there to play the whole game and with your feedback and your support, we will continue to work at the forge to complete two additional factions and lots of other sweet features.

Thank you so much for the continued support of the community and we can't wait for you to explore Oresa! 

~The Broken Spear Team
